import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]) -> dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]:
    df = inputs["rate_feed"].copy()

    # Stable sort replicating cursor ORDER BY account_id, obs_date, obs_seq
    df_sorted = df.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "obs_date", "obs_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Last-observation-carried-forward within each account_id group only
    filled = df_sorted.groupby("account_id")["rate"].ffill()

    was_carried = (df_sorted["rate"].isna() & filled.notna()).astype("int64")

    result = pd.DataFrame({
        "account_id": df_sorted["account_id"],
        "obs_seq": df_sorted["obs_seq"],
        "obs_date": df_sorted["obs_date"],
        "rate_filled": filled,
        "was_carried": was_carried,
    })

    return {"rate_filled": result}
